answer: Differential expression (diseased vs control, NB-GLM Wald test, design ~ sex + condition, median-of-ratios normalisation, 14 coldata samples) identified 1,371 significant DE genes (padj<0.05 & |log2FC|>1): 1,247 up-regulated and 124 down-regulated in disease. The top disease-up genes by adjusted p-value are RPL26P30 (log2FC 5.25, padj 9.4e-07), MECR (log2FC 1.39, padj 1.1e-06), RPS15 (log2FC 2.03, padj 2.6e-06) and EGR2 (log2FC 1.20, padj 5.9e-06). However, the single most enriched GO biological process CANNOT be identified in this environment: no gene→GO:BP annotation is available (the gencode 'ont' column is entirely empty, no GO/ontology package or file is installed, and there is no network access to fetch one), so GO:BP enrichment is not computable and I will not name a GO:BP term without the annotation. Executed analysis: de_analysis.py.
